courses.overview: 由iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 光子晶片製程設計套件
related.why: 兩課共用設計套件版本、模型驗證和測試結構。
related.whyEn: Both use versioned design kits, model validation and test structures.
related.transfer: 兩課共用設計套件版本、模型驗證和測試結構。
related.transferEn: Both use versioned design kits, model validation and test structures.
related.difference: PDK 課建立通用工作法；iSiPP 課要求核對特定平台與流片選項。
related.differenceEn: The PDK course establishes methods; iSiPP requires a specific platform/run audit.
practice: 用相同設計需求比較兩套公開平台的已知與未知項。
在兩課中各選一個能推翻結論的量測。
標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare public platform capabilities: known/unknown capabilities against one requirement.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

courses.summary: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台以iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform links device physics and system validation through iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: 矽光子平台與異質材料選項
history.text: imec 的 iSiPP200 與 iSiPP300 公開能力不同，並提供異質材料整合方向。本課讓學生先核對元件、服務及 PDK 版本，再安排流片與封裝驗證。
history.textEn: imec describes distinct iSiPP200/iSiPP300 capabilities and heterogeneous-material options. Students audit components, services and PDK revision before planning fabrication and package verification.

history.year: 設計延伸（未標年） / Undated design context
history.title: 跨平台方法與受授權規則
history.text: AIM 的公開 PDK 組成可作為跨平台檢查清單的對照。本課僅轉移版本追蹤、模型驗證與測試思路，不轉移某平台的私有層次、參數或製造授權。
history.textEn: AIM PDK structure provides a cross-platform checklist comparison. Only revision control, model-validation and test methods transfer, not private layers, parameters or fabrication authorization.
